scope: Native logical flow navigation and separate paragraph creation before/after selected image, visible table or rule; additive Wasm/SDK capability, explicit V2 controls and keyboard routing. Existing selections and InsertBlocks remain the saved representation.

contracts.movement: A proved whole node or collapsed caret at the requested UTF-16 edge moves to the adjacent logical stop. Lists/tasks/quotes are transparent; image/visible table/rule are opaque. Hidden tables are skipped. Nearest cell/caption/document defines the domain. Range/grid/interior and boundaries do not publish or discard endpoints.
contracts.traversal: Adjacent sibling/ancestor walk plus iterative destination-edge descent, retaining one bounded path rather than a document-wide flattened index or wide child frontier. Not a latency or whole-owner memory qualification.
contracts.publication: Guarded ordinary selection publication, including in read-only mode; content, causal frames, Undo and Redo remain intact. Context-dependent pending styles clear on actual moves. Existing DOM intent fences may separately close typing continuation.
contracts.creation: Whole selected image/visible table/rule, writable policy and fresh paragraph ID. Native exact before/after gap keeps the actual root/cell/quote/list/task parent, source node and sibling order; plain paragraph caret0 and cleared pending override. Existing InsertBlocks is one explicit/natural history unit.
contracts.concurrency: Concurrent paragraph births remain independent. Creator Undo hides its paragraph without erasing foreign causal text; Redo and exact recovery retain that text. No replacement of a shared AST register.
contracts.capability: Exact local flowNavigationVersion() string1; shared flow_navigation_version() string1 plus navigate_flow and insert_paragraph_adjacent. Missing/wrong capability rejects explicit commands without JS placement fallback. V1 factories/stock UI stay unchanged; optional V1 controls are explicit public exports.
contracts.browser: Stock V2 Previous/Next block and Paragraph before/after controls; Alt PageUp/PageDown requests logical movement independent of toolbar. Selected atom Enter creates after, Shift Enter before. Native widgets/composition own keys. Logical shortcuts cancel defaults even on refusal/boundary so browser paging cannot collapse a range. These are not physical/bidi arrow semantics.
contracts.compatibility: No document/schema/model/journal/frame/checkpoint version change. New saved selections and creation histories restore in actual pre-capability runtimes. New commands are convenience entry points, not persisted action tags.
